children: Stanford Spogli Institute for International Studies Senior Fellow Francis Fukuyama said the Iran war risks repeating lessons from Iraq and Afghanistan, arguing military power alone is unlikely to produce lasting political change, according to Bloomberg.

In discussing his new memoir, In the Realm of the Last Man, Fukuyama also warned that the rapid advance of AI could outpace governments' ability to regulate it and challenge the role work plays in giving people purpose.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Fukuyama Says Iran War Risks Repeating Iraq, Afghanistan Lessons
